notes.title: 0.4.0 - Major update (Paws & Chaos)
notes.content:
First off, thank you all so much for your continued support. The kind words, bug reports, and amazing Steam reviews have been a huge source of motivation for me. I couldn’t have come this far without you.

If you encounter any issues, please don’t hesitate to report them. I’m already working on the next update, which will let you have multiple pets and includes quality-of-life improvements based on your feedback,  like customers *actually* using the trash bins. You’ll also be able to customize your employees!



But, let's get to what’s new in this major update:



NEW FEATURES

New decorations: tables, chairs, art, and more  

TV where you can play local video clips (I want to add youtube soon)

Balls for playing fetch with pets  

Food and water systems for pets  

Dogs can now act as Security and stop thieves  

Thieves added — some customers will try to steal your art  

Weapon added (Hold TAB) to defend your shop from thieves  

Knock-out system with ragdoll physics — target carefully!  

New sound effects across multiple items  

3 new radio songs:  

 – Art Thieves Are Among Us  

 – An Artist’s Best Friend  

 – Paws of Paint  

Shop settings added: toggle haggling, garbage, and thieves  

F6 now activates Photo Mode to capture cool screenshots  



CHANGES

Customers now evaluate art and may reject it  

Market screen now displays a loading icon on first load  

Playing fetch boosts your pet’s performance  

Knocked-out customers despawn after 120 seconds  

Customers now react with sounds based on art preferences  



FIXES

Fixed issue with items getting stuck behind walls  

Improved performance during sunset  

Fixed pets moving while being petted  

Translation fixes related to trash cans  

Fixed shadow glitches while drawing in sunlight  

Fixed customer spawn bug when saving during drink serving  

Resolved memory leak from large imported drawings  

General CPU and localization optimizations

notes.title: Big update - 0.3.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s hard to believe, but it’s only been one and a half month since launch - and thanks to you, we’ve already passed thousands of copies sold!
Seriously, thank you from the bottom of my heart. Every single one of you who played the game, sent feedback, shared a funny moment, or just told a friend - you’ve helped shape the game into what it is today. 🖌️

Today, I’m beyond excited to finally release Update 0.3.0 - Part 1, the first half of our biggest update yet! Part 2 will be launched sometime this week. I need a few more days to complete the new employees.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080618/f37aa9b707f03d95ed64d59bfe895ff8feeb37dd.png

🆕 New Features
✨ Placeable Items & Decorations — Your shop can now feel even more alive! Add little items and decorations to your tables and furniture.

✨ Drink Shop — Thirsty customers are happy customers. Stock up on drinks and serve them to boost moods and sales!

✨ Happiness System — Customers now have happiness levels. Happier customers spend more, but unhappy ones… not so much. Keep them smiling!

✨ Energy System — Customers won't stay forever! If their energy hits zero, they'll head for the door. Plan your shop and services wisely.

✨ Celebrity Visitors — If you’re Reputation 8+, keep an eye out... Celebrities are in town! They have deep pockets but sky-high expectations.
(Pro tip: Don’t make them angry. They can tank your reputation!)

✨ Placement Grid — Now you can finally arrange your floor and ceiling items with satisfying precision. No more chaotic lamp disasters!

✨ New Achievements — 8 brand-new achievements to chase! (Bragging rights included.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080618/0f1bfaff12c28209a0d2610a7a4ac9626392c46e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080618/d334c751f02b7c0a9aab86537159ea9811864598.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080618/3503ee3112b548e3114d06dcf8fbed03aa593ced.png

🔧 Improvements & Fixes
🛠️ Better market organization with two new categories
🛠️ Art now shows its name right on the piece
🛠️ Helpful new hint for placing lights
🛠️ Scrollbar added to the market shop
🛠️ Haggling now unlocks after your first expansion (better pacing!)
🛠️ Memory leak related to walls fixed
🛠️ Inbox now shows the newest mail on top
🛠️ Doors now open for pets (as they should!)
🛠️ Truck color fixes (yes, it can be green now!)
🛠️ Lighting bugs squashed
🛠️ Various minor bugfixes to make everything smoother

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080618/f9883c34d46b237395f4767ef0ddacbfd79cabd6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080618/124f365ecd08cc384699e46ac870dac7e82dd5a8.png

🔜 What’s Coming Next (Part 2!)
This is just Part 1 of the update — I’m already putting the final touches on Part 2, which will arrive in just a few days! Here’s a sneak peek:

🌟 Art Viewings — Customers will gather around your masterpieces and react!
🌟 Serving Drinks at Events — Boost your events with some refreshments.
🌟 New Hireable Employees — Including haggling assistants!
🌟 Revamped Haggling System — Make deals feel more like real conversations.

Part 2 will bring even more life and personality to your shop. I can't wait for you to see it!

Thank you again for being such an amazing community.
Watching your shops grow, seeing your creations, hearing your ideas — it's been one of the most rewarding experiences of my life. 🎨
This is only the beginning... and we’re building something truly special together.

Stay awesome, and I’ll see you in the shop! 🖌️✨

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions in Art Shop Simulator
notes.content:
Since launching Art Shop Simulator, I’ve received amazing feedback, and I truly appreciate all your support! However, I’ve noticed some common questions and misunderstandings about how the game works. To help you get the best experience, I’ve put together this Q&A and Tips & Tricks guide. Future updates will also include better in-game explanations, but for now, let’s clear things up!  

---  

Q&A – Your Questions Answered

Q: My customers think everything is too expensive, but I priced it based on market value.  
A: Art is worth what people are willing to pay! In the early game, don’t focus too much on market value—pay attention to the daily market trend report sent via in-game email. Your reputation attracts wealthier customers, so as you grow, you can increase prices.  

Q: Then why does art have a market value?  
A: This feature will become more important in future updates when you can host award ceremonies and sell art to competitor shops. For now, you can ignore it.  

Q: I’m bad at drawing—can I just buy and sell art instead?  
A: The game encourages creating your own art early on, but if drawing isn’t your thing, you can import images and sell them. Later, you’ll unlock the ability to buy and resell art. Customers also sometimes bring in hidden art—but be careful, some pieces may not be worth it!  

Q: I keep going bankrupt! What am I doing wrong?  
A: You’re likely pricing too low. If no customers complain about high prices, you’re probably underpricing. Ideally, 10-15% of customers should think your prices are too high—this means you’ve found the sweet spot!  

Q: What does the Twitch integration do?  
A: If you connect Twitch, your viewers will visit your store! They might buy art or even sell their own pieces to you.  

Q: What do pets do?  
A: Pets help keep your shop clean and will gain more abilities in future updates, assisting alongside employees.  

Q: Why is my pet so slow?  
A: Interact with your pet to boost its speed. The boost lasts for 4 in-game hours before you need to interact again. Pets need love!  

Q: Can I hire employees?  
A: Yes! Employees currently help with taking payments, and in future updates, they will also negotiate sales, serve drinks, and even create art.  

Q: How do auctions work?  
[olist]
 A: Once you’ve expanded your shop with an event hall, you can host auctions. Auctions must be started before 15:00, or you’ll need to wait until the next day. To begin:  
 Place art on the easel inside the event room.  
 Set a minimum bid before starting.  
 Move to the pedestal to begin the auction.  
 Sit back and watch the bidding war unfold!  
[/olist]

Q: After loading my save, I see art in my office.  
A: This happens if you saved while customers were holding art. When you reload, the customers aren’t there, so the art drops to the ground and are moved to the office area.

Q: Is there autosave?  
A: Yes, the game autosaves at the end of each day.  

Q: Is there a roadmap?  
A: Yes! Check out the roadmap here: [/b Art Shop Simulator is Now Live in Early Access!  

Q: I found a bug—how do I report it?  
A: Join our Discord and report any bugs you find! I’m constantly updating the game, so your feedback is incredibly helpful. You can join here: https://discord.gg/bVNEytdpR3  

---  

Tips & Tricks for a Better Start


 Check your emails daily – Market trends change, and the daily report helps you price art correctly.  
 Experiment with pricing – If no one complains, you’re probably selling too cheap. Aim for some pushback from customers.  
 Use ALT for free placement – Holding LEFT ALT lets you place items without snapping to the grid.  
 Don’t forget about hidden art – Sometimes customers bring in mystery pieces—some are valuable, others not. Take risks wisely!  
 Interact with pets often – They help keep the shop clean and will have more functions in future updates.


---  

This is just the beginning for Art Shop Simulator! More updates are coming, and I’m listening to all your feedback. Keep sharing your thoughts in Discord, and let’s make this the best art shop experience together!  

Happy painting and selling!

notes.title: First Patch is Here! – V.0.2.1 Update
notes.content:
Hello, art shop owners!

Our first patch since launching Art Shop Simulator in Early Access is here! This update brings new decorations, quality-of-life improvements, and important bug fixes. A huge thank you to everyone sharing feedback in our Discord - your input helps shape the game! This is just the beginning, and more updates are on the way.

What’s New?
We’ve added 13 new decorative plants, a wooden bench, a direction sign, and hanging lights to help you design an even more beautiful gallery.

Improvements & Changes

 New Placement Option: Hold LEFT ALT to place items freely without snapping to the grid.
 New Customer Interaction: A new reply option prevents customers from leaving too soon.
 Mail System Update: You can now delete emails.
 Exit Confirmation: A prompt now appears when exiting without saving.
 Market & Pricing Tweaks: Customer art prices are lower, locked items are clearer, and market loading is faster.
 Drawing Enhancements: You can now draw while hovering over the canvas frame, and the top bar in the drawing panel is easier to understand.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a soft-lock issue with the trash can while hovering over a canvas.
 Fixed market scrolling while hovering buttons.
 Fixed pets not respawning in bed after being re-adopted.
 Fixed disabled market buttons still playing click sounds.
 Thank you for your support! Keep sharing your feedback, and we’ll keep improving the game. More exciting updates are coming soon!


See you in the shop! 🎨

notes.title: Art Shop Simulator is Now Live in Early Access!
notes.content:
The wait is over - Art Shop Simulator is officially released in Early Access! As a solo developer, I’ve poured my heart into this project, and today marks the start of an exciting journey. Step into the world of art trading, build your dream gallery, and grow from a struggling shop owner to a thriving curator.

What’s in the Game?

 Buy & Sell Art – Discover unique pieces, set prices, and negotiate with customers to grow your business.
 Shop Customization – Decorate your gallery to create the perfect atmosphere and attract more visitors.
 Pets as Helpers – Adopt furry companions to keep your shop clean and lively.
 Dynamic Customers – Handle different personalities, bargain hunters, and art enthusiasts.
 Emerging Events – Experience unexpected moments that challenge your skills as a shop owner.

This is just the beginning! As an Early Access title, Art Shop Simulator will continue to evolve with frequent updates, new features, and improvements. Your feedback will help shape the game’s future, and I truly appreciate every bit of support.

If you want to be part of this journey, join our Discord to share ideas, report issues, and stay updated on upcoming content.

Being a solo developer means every purchase, every review, and every piece of feedback means the world to me. Thank you for believing in this project - I can’t wait to see the incredible galleries you create!

notes.title: Art Shop Simulator Early Access - Release date update
notes.content:
Today was supposed to be the day. March 6th, 18:00 CET - the moment Art Shop Simulator would finally be in your hands. I’ve poured my heart into this game, worked tirelessly to make it something special, and I was so ready to celebrate this milestone with all of you. But now, I have to share some really disheartening news.

For the past weeks, I’ve been in constant dialogue with Valve, waiting for the game to be reviewed and approved for release. The build was submitted on February 23rd, and yet, as of today, it still hasn’t been checked. I’ve asked for an estimate, but Valve has told me they simply don’t know when they’ll get to it. This means I have no choice but to delay the launch - possibly for a few days, maybe even weeks - until they finally give the green light.

I can’t even begin to explain how frustrating and heartbreaking this is. I’ve held off on saying anything because every day, I’ve woken up thinking, Maybe today’s the day; only to end up waiting again. I didn’t want to disappoint you, and honestly, I didn’t want to face the reality that this might happen. But here we are.

I know this isn’t the news you wanted to hear, and trust me, it hurts me more than I can say. But I want to make something good out of this setback. Since I had already planned to spend the next days on bug fixes, I’ll use this time to add a little extra polish - and even a few more pets - to the game. It won’t erase the disappointment, but I hope it’ll bring a small silver lining.

Thank you for your patience, your understanding, and most of all, your support. This delay doesn’t change the fact that Art Shop Simulator is coming, and when it does, I promise it will be worth the wait. And I promise you I will keep you guys updated as soon as I get new information, my mission is to get this game out ASAP!
